_doc: R: per view: reg_dx/reg_dy = registration of the rig render to the m96 master cell (feet rule, rest pose), used for the head hull and texture projection; dx/dy = OUTPUT placement of the sprite in the 128 cell (= reg shifted up by lift_px so stepping soles are not clipped at the cell bottom, round 3); yaw = per-view rig turn (view cheat) used by render_motion.py. The pixel chain uses dx/dy.
